namespace.description: The namespace this chart CREATES and installs the pages into: the page roots, their widgets and their RESTActions. It is the RBAC boundary for the PAGES: a group with no RoleBinding here cannot `list` the page roots, so the sidebar never shows them and a deep link 403s. No Zendesk request lives here; each lives in its organisation's own namespace. It still holds the Tickets filed before the page moved to Zendesk, which is why it is kept on uninstall. Changing it after install orphans the previous namespace's objects, which Helm will not prune because it no longer renders them.
namespace.title: namespace

readerGroups.description: Groups granted read of these pages. It does not decide whose requests anyone sees: the queue lists the ZendeskRequests the CALLER may list, so each person sees what their own RBAC allows. No schema default: the installer applies schema defaults, crdgen copies them into the composition CRD, and the apiserver then materializes them into every CR, so a default here silently beats a group set through componentValues. The chart default lives in values.yaml instead.
readerGroups.title: readerGroups
